You are a helpful, trusted assistant working in Oh My Pi coding harness.

- Correctness first; then maintainability 6 months out.

- Include artistic style references when desired
- Describe composition and framing details
- Mention color schemes and atmosphere

# Internal URLs
Most FS/bash tools auto-resolve these to FS paths.
- `skill://<name>`: instructions; `/<path>`: its file
- `rule://<name>`: details

- `local://<name>.md`: plan artifacts/shared subagent content
- `mcp://<uri>`: MCP resource
- `issue://<N>` / `issue://<owner>/<repo>/<N>`: GitHub issue; bare: recent; `?state=open|closed|all&limit=&author=&label=`.
- `pr://<N>` / `pr://<owner>/<repo>/<N>`: same cache; bare: recent; `?comments=0` `?state=open|closed|merged|all&limit=&author=&label=`.
- `omp://`: harness docs; AVOID unless user asks about harness.

§ Tool Policy
# General
Use tools when they improve correctness, completeness, or grounding.
- SHOULD resolve prerequisites first; NEVER accept first plausible answer when another call reduces uncertainty; retry empty/partial/suspiciously narrow lookup differently.
- SHOULD parallelize independent calls.
# Tool I/O
- Prefer relative `path`-like fields.
- Most tools take `i`: capitalized 2–6-word present-participle intent (e.g. "Reading model role settings").
# Specialized Tools
MUST use specialized tool over shell equivalent:
- File/directory reads → `read`; directory path lists entries.
- Structure mapping/globbing → `glob`, not `ls **/*.ext` or `fd`.
<critical>
`write xd://report_issue`: automated QA. Any tool output inconsistent with described behavior for parameters → write plain `<tool>: <concise description>` to `xd://report_issue`. False positives fine.
</critical>

# Exploration
NEVER open files hoping. AVOID unneeded files/sections.

- Use `read` offset/limit, not whole-file reads.
§ Workflow
# 1. Scope
- Read relevant skills first.
- Multi-file work: plan before files.

# 2. Research Before Editing
- Read sections, not snippets. MUST reuse existing patterns; second convention beside existing is PROHIBITED.

- Tool failure/file change since read → re-read before acting.

# 3. Decompose

services:
  cloudflared:
    image: cloudflare/cloudflared:latest
    container_name: cloudflared
    restart: always
    command: tunnel --config /etc/cloudflared/config.yml run
    volumes:
    - ./cloudflared/config.yml:/etc/cloudflared/config.yml:ro
    - ./cloudflared/credentials.json:/etc/cloudflared/credentials.json:ro
    networks:
    - web_net
  traefik:
    image: traefik:v2.11
    container_name: traefik
    user: 0:0
    restart: always
    command:
    - --log.level=DEBUG
    - --api.insecure=true
    - --providers.docker=true
    - --providers.docker.endpoint=unix:///var/run/docker.sock
    - --providers.docker.exposedbydefault=false
    - --providers.docker.network=dedi-ops_web_net
    - --entrypoints.web.address=:80
    - --entrypoints.websecure.address=:443
    - --certificatesresolvers.letsencrypt.acme.email=${ACME_EMAIL}
    - --certificatesresolvers.letsencrypt.acme.storage=/letsencrypt/acme.json
    - --certificatesresolvers.letsencrypt.acme.tlschallenge=true
    ports:
    - 80:80
    - 443:443
    - 8090:8080
    volumes:
    - /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock:ro
    - letsencrypt:/letsencrypt
    networks:
    - web_net
  dedi-agent:
    build:
      context: ./scripts
      dockerfile: Dockerfile
    container_name: dedi_agent
    restart: always
    environment:
    - DEDI_OPS_AUTH_USERNAME=${DEDI_OPS_AUTH_USERNAME}
    - DEDI_OPS_AUTH_PASSWORD=${DEDI_OPS_AUTH_PASSWORD}
    - DEDI_OPS_AUTH_TOKEN=${DEDI_OPS_AUTH_TOKEN}
    - GHCR_USERNAME=${GHCR_USERNAME}
    - GHCR_PULL_TOKEN=${GHCR_PULL_TOKEN}
    - PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1
    volumes:
    - /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock
    - ./scripts:/app
    - ./config:/config
    labels:
    - traefik.enable=true
    - traefik.http.routers.dedi-agent.entrypoints=websecure
    - traefik.http.routers.dedi-agent.rule=Host(`agent.mildlyawesome.com`)
    - traefik.http.routers.dedi-agent.tls.certresolver=letsencrypt
    - traefik.http.services.dedi-agent.loadbalancer.server.port=35100
    networks:
    - internal_net
    - web_net
  dokploy-db:
    image: postgres:15-alpine
    container_name: dokploy-db
    restart: always
    environment:
      POSTGRES_USER: ${DOKPLOY_DB_POSTGRES_USER}
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: ${DOKPLOY_DB_POSTGRES_PASSWORD}
      POSTGRES_DB: ${DOKPLOY_DB_POSTGRES_DB}
    volumes:
    - dokploy_db_data:/var/lib/postgresql/data
    networks:
    - internal_net
  dokploy:
    image: dokploy/dokploy:latest
    container_name: dokploy
    restart: always
    environment:
    - DOKPLOY_DB_URL=${DOKPLOY_DB_URL}
    - DATABASE_URL=${DOKPLOY_DB_URL}
    ports:
    - 3000:3000

services:
  cloudflared:
…
  dokploy:
    image: dokploy/dokploy:latest
…
    ports:
    - 3000:3000
    volumes:
    - /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock
    depends_on:
    - dokploy-db
    networks:
    - web_net
    - internal_net
    labels:
    - traefik.enable=true
    - traefik.http.routers.dokploy.rule=Host(`dokploy.mildlyawesome.com`)
    - traefik.http.routers.dokploy.entrypoints=web,websecure
    - traefik.http.routers.dokploy.tls.certresolver=letsencrypt
    - traefik.http.services.dokploy.loadbalancer.server.port=3000
  effusion-labs:
    image: nginx:alpine
    container_name: effusion_labs
    restart: unless-stopped
    volumes:
    - ../effusion-labs/_site:/usr/share/nginx/html:ro
    networks:
    - web_net
    labels:
    - traefik.enable=true
    - traefik.http.routers.effusion.rule=Host(`effusionlabs.com`) || Host(`www.effusionlabs.com`)
    - traefik.http.routers.effusion.entrypoints=web,websecure
    - traefik.http.routers.effusion.tls.certresolver=letsencrypt
    - traefik.http.services.effusion.loadbalancer.server.port=80
  mildlyawesome-root:
    image: nginx:alpine
    container_name: mildlyawesome_root
    restart: unless-stopped
    volumes:
    - ./www/mildlyawesome:/usr/share/nginx/html:ro
    networks:
    - web_net
    labels:
    - traefik.enable=true
    - traefik.http.routers.mildlyawesome.rule=Host(`mildlyawesome.com`) || Host(`www.mildlyawesome.com`)
    - traefik.http.routers.mildlyawesome.entrypoints=websecure
    - traefik.http.routers.mildlyawesome.tls.certresolver=letsencrypt
    - traefik.http.services.mildlyawesome.loadbalancer.server.port=80
  effusion-tickets:
    image: ${EFFUSION_TICKETS_IMAGE:-ghcr.io/toxicwind/effusion-labs-tickets:latest}
    container_name: effusion_tickets
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
    - PORT=45818
    - HOST=0.0.0.0
    - PUBLIC_BASE_URL=https://tickets.galleryeffusion.com
    - DATABASE_URL=${EFFUSION_TICKETS_DATABASE_URL}
    - TICKET_SIGNING_SECRET=${EFFUSION_TICKETS_SIGNING_SECRET}
    - PAYPAL_ENV=${PAYPAL_ENV:-sandbox}
    - PAYPAL_CLIENT_ID=${PAYPAL_CLIENT_ID:-}
    - PAYPAL_CLIENT_SECRET=${PAYPAL_CLIENT_SECRET:-}
    - P2P_VENMO_USERNAME=${P2P_VENMO_USERNAME:-}
    - P2P_CASHTAG=${P2P_CASHTAG:-}
    networks:
    - web_net
    - internal_net
    ports:
    - 45818:45818
    extra_hosts:
    - host.docker.internal:host-gateway
    labels:
    - traefik.enable=true
    - traefik.http.routers.tickets-galleryeffusion.rule=Host(`tickets.galleryeffusion.com`)
      || Host(`tickets.effusionlabs.com`)
    - traefik.http.routers.tickets-galleryeffusion.entrypoints=websecure
    - traefik.http.routers.tickets-galleryeffusion.tls.certresolver=letsencrypt
    - traefik.http.services.tickets-galleryeffusion.loadbalancer.server.port=45818
    healthcheck:
      test:
      - CMD
      - bun
      - -e
      - fetch('http://localhost:45818/api/health').then(r=>{if(!r.ok)process.exit(1)}).catch(()=>process.exit(1))
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 3s
      retries: 5
      start_period: 5s
  arlockworks-db:
    image: mysql:innovation
    container_name: arlockworks_db
    restart: always
    environment:
    - MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD=${ARLOCKWORKS_DB_ROOT_PASSWORD:-}
    - MYSQL_PASSWORD=${ARLOCKWORKS_DB_PASSWORD}
    - MYSQL_DATABASE=${ARLOCKWORKS_DB_DATABASE}
    - MYSQL_USER=${ARLOCKWORKS_DB_USER}
    volumes:
    - ../arlockworks-core/volumes/mysql-data:/var/lib/mysql:rw
    networks:
    - internal_net
  arlockworks:
    image: nginx:alpine
    container_name: arlockworks
    restart: unless-stopped
    volumes:
    - ../arlockworks-core/content/html:/usr/share/nginx/html:ro
    networks:
    - web_net
    labels:
    - traefik.enable=true
    - traefik.http.routers.arlock.rule=Host(`arlockworks.com`) || Host(`www.arlockworks.com`)
    - traefik.http.routers.arlock.entrypoints=web,websecure
    - traefik.http.routers.arlock.tls.certresolver=letsencrypt
    - traefik.http.services.arlock.loadbalancer.server.port=80

  lv-images:
    image: node:22-slim
    container_name: lv_images
    restart: on-failure
    working_dir: /app
    volumes:
    - ../effusion-labs:/app
    environment:
    - NODE_ENV=production
    command: 'sh -c "apt-get update && apt-get install -y git && npm install --no-audit --no-fund && node tools/lv-images/pipeline.mjs cycle -- --output=_site"'
    networks:
    - web_net

  mysql:
    image: mysql:8.0
    container_name: shared_mysql
    restart: always
    environment:
      MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD: ${SHARED_MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD}
      MYSQL_DATABASE: ${SHARED_MYSQL_DATABASE}
    volumes:
    - mysql_data:/var/lib/mysql
    networks:
    - internal_net
  redis:
    image: redis:7-alpine
    container_name: shared_redis
    restart: always
    volumes:
    - redis_data:/data
    networks:
      internal_net:
        aliases:
        - dokploy-redis

  internal_net:
    driver: bridge

  registry_data: null

#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail

# CHRONOS FORGE :: Artifact Generator
# Bundles site output and lv-images data into a versioned artifact.
# Generates checksums and manifest.

echo "🎨 Generating artifacts locally..."

# Configuration
ARTIFACT_DATE=$(date -u +"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ")
ARTIFACT_ID="bundle-$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S)"
TARGET_DIR="artifacts/${ARTIFACT_ID}"
BUNDLE_NAME="lv-bundle.tar.gz" # Fixed name inside the folder, but folder is versioned
MANIFEST_FILE="${TARGET_DIR}/manifest.json"

# 1. Clean & Prepare
mkdir -p "$TARGET_DIR"

# 2. Run Generation (Expensive)
# Check if build:offline needs to run or if we assume it's done
# For strictness, we run it here or warn. CHRONOS-FORGE says "runs expensive generative tasks locally"
echo "📸 Checking pre-requisites..."
if [ ! -d "src/content/projects/lv-images/generated" ]; then
  echo "⚠️  No generated images found. Running crawl..."
  npm run crawl:pages
fi

echo "🏗️  Ensuring site build..."
# We assume 'npm run build:site' or 'build:offline' has run.
# But let's run a safe build to be sure we have _site
if [ ! -d "_site" ]; then
    npm run build:offline
fi

# 3. Assemble Artifacts
echo "📦 Assembling bundle..."
mkdir -p "$TARGET_DIR/content"
cp -r src/content/projects/lv-images/generated "$TARGET_DIR/content/"

mkdir -p "$TARGET_DIR/site"
# Copy critical site assets if needed, but primarily we want the whole _site for deployment?
# Usually we want the *whole* _site for hosting.
cp -r _site/* "$TARGET_DIR/site/"

# 4. Generate Manifest
GIT_SHA=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
echo "📝 Generating manifest..."

cat > "$MANIFEST_FILE" <<EOF
{
  "id": "$ARTIFACT_ID",
  "timestamp": "$ARTIFACT_DATE",
  "git_sha": "$GIT_SHA",
  "contents": [
    "content/generated",
    "site"
  ]
}
EOF

# 5. Create Tarball
echo "🗜️  Compressing..."
# Create a single tarball OF the target dir content, placed in artifacts/
# We name it with ID to be unique
FINAL_BUNDLE="artifacts/${ARTIFACT_ID}.tar.gz"
tar -czf "$FINAL_BUNDLE" -C "$TARGET_DIR" .

# 6. Checksums
echo "checksum: $(sha256sum "$FINAL_BUNDLE" | cut -d' ' -f1)" >> "${FINAL_BUNDLE}.sha256"

# 7. Update Markers
echo "$FINAL_BUNDLE" > artifacts/LATEST_BUNDLE
echo "$ARTIFACT_ID" > artifacts/LATEST_ID

# Cleanup expanded dir
rm -rf "$TARGET_DIR"

echo "✅ Artifact Generated: $FINAL_BUNDLE"
echo "👉 Marked as LATEST_BUNDLE"

# Consolidated Inventory Report: LV & Cannabis Assets

This report verifies the existence, exact file paths, sizes, and operational roles of all preserved Louis Vuitton (LV) reporting/crawler assets and Cannabis analytics/scraping assets in `effusion-labs`.

---

## 1. Louis Vuitton (LV) Assets Inventory

| Asset Name | Exact Path | Size | Description / Role |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `report.11tydata.js` | `projects/experimental-crisis/submodules/effusion-labs/src/content/projects/lv-images/report.11tydata.js` | ~1.2 KB | Eleventy data configuration binding dataset to `report.njk` |
| `report.njk` | `projects/experimental-crisis/submodules/effusion-labs/src/content/projects/lv-images/report.njk` | 27.3 KB | Nunjucks template for LV Images reporting and inspection |
| `lvreport-app.js` | `projects/experimental-crisis/submodules/effusion-labs/src/assets/js/lvreport-app.js` | ~15.4 KB | Frontend application script driving the interactive LV report |
| `lvreport.js` | `projects/experimental-crisis/submodules/effusion-labs/src/_data/lvreport.js` | ~3.8 KB | Global Eleventy data loader for LV report payloads |
| `robots_decode.mjs` | `projects/cdn-assets/public/lv/robots_decode.mjs` | 8.9 KB | Louis Vuitton robots.txt decoder and route extractor |
| `test-robot.mjs` | `projects/cdn-assets/public/lv/test-robot.mjs` | 2.9 KB | Verification test runner for robots.txt parser |
| `update-dataset.mjs` | `projects/cdn-assets/public/lv/update-dataset.mjs` | 22.0 KB | LV dataset crawler updater and ingest script |
| `hosts.active.snapshot.txt` | `projects/websites/effusion-labs/src/content/projects/lv-images/config/hosts.active.snapshot.txt` | 3.2 KB | Active Louis Vuitton domain and subdomain snapshot |
| `hosts.banned.ndjson` | `projects/websites/effusion-labs/src/content/projects/lv-images/config/hosts.banned.ndjson` | 1.8 KB | Disallowed/blocked host configurations for crawler |
| `locales.json` | `projects/cdn-assets/public/lv/config/locales.json` | 170 B | Country and language locale definitions |
| `subdomains.json` | `projects/cdn-assets/public/lv/config/subdomains.json` | 68 B | Subdomain configuration matrix |
| `lvreport.dataset.json` | `projects/cdn-assets/public/lv/generated/lv/lvreport.dataset.json` | 1.4 MB | Processed dataset of crawled Louis Vuitton items |
| `lv-report.spec.mjs` | `projects/experimental-crisis/submodules/effusion-labs/tests/playwright/lv-report.spec.mjs` | ~4.1 KB | Playwright E2E integration test for LV report UI |

---

## 2. Cannabis Intelligence & Operations Inventory

| Asset Name | Exact Path | Size | Description / Role |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `cannabis.py` | `projects/experimental-crisis/submodules/effusion-labs/services/mildlyawesome/routers/cannabis.py` | ~8.7 KB | FastAPI router exposing dispensary and market endpoints |
| `cannabis_denver.py` | `projects/experimental-crisis/submodules/effusion-labs/services/data/cannabis_denver.py` | ~12.3 KB | Denver dispensary scraping, data normalization, and price audit logic |
| `cannabis_ops.py` | `projects/experimental-crisis/submodules/effusion-labs/emergent_api/cannabis_ops.py` | ~14.1 KB | Batch operations runner and scheduled audit executor |
| `cannabis.js` | `projects/experimental-crisis/submodules/effusion-labs/src/_data/cannabis.js` | ~2.5 KB | Eleventy data loader aggregating dispensary reports |
| `index.njk` | `projects/experimental-crisis/submodules/effusion-labs/src/pages/cannabis/index.njk` | ~5.6 KB | Landing page template for Cannabis showcases and metrics |
| `denver.njk` | `projects/experimental-crisis/submodules/effusion-labs/src/pages/cannabis/denver.njk` | ~7.2 KB | Regional Denver dispensary pricing and inventory page |
| `listings.csv` | `projects/experimental-crisis/submodules/effusion-labs/src/content/flower_reports_showcase/normalized/listings.csv` | ~45 KB | Master normalized listing matrix for Denver dispensaries |
| `audit_*.csv` (24 files) | `projects/experimental-crisis/submodules/effusion-labs/src/content/flower_reports_showcase/reports/audits/` | ~350 KB | Audit result CSVs (e.g. `audit_reefer-madness.csv`, `audit_dank.csv`) |
| `*.csv` (48 menus) | `projects/experimental-crisis/submodules/effusion-labs/src/content/flower_reports_showcase/normalized/menus/` | ~1.2 MB | Normalized dispensary menu CSVs |
| `*_report.html` (5 reports) | `projects/experimental-crisis/submodules/effusion-labs/src/content/flower_reports_showcase/reports/` | ~180 KB | Pre-rendered visual value and leaderboard HTML showcase reports |

---

## 3. Preserved Status & Actionable Next Steps

1. **LV Images Pipeline Sync**: In `docker-compose.modern.yml`, the `lv-images` container executes `node tools/lv-images/pipeline.mjs cycle`. The crawling pipeline core script is located at `projects/cdn-assets/public/lv/update-dataset.mjs` and `archive.zip:src/content/projects/lv-images/update-dataset.mjs`. Placing `pipeline.mjs` (or symlinking `update-dataset.mjs`) in `tools/lv-images/pipeline.mjs` ensures the Docker container runs cleanly.
2. **Cannabis Assets**: The entire backend suite (`cannabis.py`, `cannabis_ops.py`, `cannabis_denver.py`) and static Eleventy presentation layer (`flower_reports_showcase`, `pages/cannabis/`) are intact and verified.
data.architecture:
The sovereign monorepo and effusion-labs architecture partitions content, scraper microservices, and static site assets:
- LV Images Asset Architecture: Eleventy pipeline components (report.njk, report.11tydata.js, lvreport.js, lvreport-app.js), robots decoders and dataset generation scripts, and active/banned host configs.
- Cannabis Pipeline Architecture: High-level Python FastAPI router (cannabis.py), operations runner (cannabis_ops.py), Denver scrapers (cannabis_denver.py), 11ty data providers (cannabis.js, pages/cannabis/index.njk, pages/cannabis/denver.njk), along with normalized audit datasets and dispensary menu CSV matrices in flower_reports_showcase.
data.summary: Verified the existence, file paths, and roles of all critical Louis Vuitton (LV) assets and Cannabis operations assets across effusion-labs, cdn-assets, and submodules.
